questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a reason why percentage yield is often less than 100%?

options.text: The reaction is reversible and does not go to completion
Atoms are destroyed during the reaction
Some product is lost during transfer between containers

questions.explanation: Atoms are never destroyed during a chemical reaction (law of conservation of mass). The other options are all valid reasons for yield being less than 100%: practical losses during transfer, side reactions forming by-products, and reversible reactions reaching equilibrium.
